surface_mechanism_description: The ALD process involves alternating exposures of bis(ethylcyclopentadienyl)magnesium (Mg(CpEt)2) and anhydrous hydrogen fluoride (HF). The use of HF as a fluorine source results in improved morphology and reduced impurity content. The reaction mechanism is expected to proceed similarly to previous reports on ALD metal fluorides, where the fluorine-containing precursor reacts with the magnesium precursor.
